# The upstream module documents a class whose related non-members are
# declared in a namespace and in the global scope. It is built first so
# that its generated .index file is on disk when the consumer module
# (built last) parses `depends = upstreamrelated`. The consumer loads the
# index in a fresh qdoc process, which must re-adopt every related
# non-member with canonical first-occurrence numbering (QTBUG-151066).
